name: legend-the-awakening
description: Production Playwright regression tooling and isolated Phaser preview checks for LEGEND: The Awakening.

scripts.test:e2e:road-map-ui-contract: playwright test tests/ui-system-v160.spec.js --grep "Old Road scene, HUD and field map keep sharp DOM copy and real controls|Phaser paints Old Road decision cards while retaining real route, detour and camp actions" --project="Desktop Chrome" --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:overlay-fallback: playwright test tests/road-opening-v140.spec.js --grep "native Annals, creation and Oric overlays recover to readable DOM when Phaser painting throws" --project="Desktop Chrome"
scripts.test:e2e:phaser-stability: playwright test tests/phaser-handoff-invalidation.spec.js tests/phaser-handoff-stability.spec.js tests/phaser-render-commit.spec.js tests/phaser-renderer-parity.spec.js tests/phaser-creation-asset-recovery.spec.js tests/phaser-creation-geometry.spec.js tests/phaser-pointer-ownership.spec.js --project="Desktop Chrome" --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:option-frames: playwright test tests/ui-world-shell-v170.spec.js --grep "persistent world-shell action frames use stone and sage states" --project="Desktop Chrome" --workers=1
